name: Reviewer starter
author: Mode
description: A pull-request reviewer agent with a nightly review session.

agents.name: Reviewer
agents.title: Reviews pull requests
agents.instructions: Review the open pull requests of this repository. For each one, read the diff, run the tests the change touches, and leave one comment per finding: what is wrong, where, and the smallest fix. Approve only when every test passes and nothing is left unexplained.

action.prompt: Review every open pull request and leave your findings as comments.
